scope: Node.js package-manager tests with in-memory Storage and deterministic mocked payload downloads; IndexedDB transaction behavior contract-checked, not browser-executed

results.name: IndexedDB storage commits package data and active pointer in a single transaction
Install activates a verified version with a unique immutable record ID
Installing a new version retains a rollback candidate and atomically activates latest
Rollback switches active pointer to previous verified version without deleting the newer version
Inspect follows active pointer instead of choosing newest installed timestamp
Failed integrity verification does not activate or replace the stable package
Rollback refuses to activate unverified or empty-payload packages
Rollback reports absence of an earlier version without deleting current package
Retention policy keeps at most two verified versions for one package
Current release version and service-worker cache align to Batch 47
Package manager uses atomic activation and no longer deletes the active version during rollback
